groups.note: Plant capacity factor. One plant-level entry point since the model migration (the four consuming calcs bind it by the `_in` convention); it reaches replacement costing, fuel throughput, and the two LCOE variants.
Discount / interest rate. One plant-level entry point (`discount_rate`) since the model migration; it reaches CAS71, CAS72, CAS80 levelization and IDC.
Plasma major radius, one plant-level entry point since the model migration (was the geom__R / rb__R fan-out).
R together with its declared physical-identity tie, the magnet coil major radius.
Plasma minor radius, one plant-level entry point since the model migration (was the geom__a / rb__a fan-out).

Axis-averaged on-axis field, one magnet-part entry point. Since WI-030 it reaches beta_ok through 'Volume-Averaged Beta' and peak_field_ok through 'Conductor Peak Field' (both computed-vs-bound), and the magnet cost. The retired bound-input beta axis lived here before.
